prompts.title: Trending Doodle Shadow
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference. Preserve the reference character’s face identity, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, visible accessories, overall recognizable vibe, outfit and styling shown in the reference image

Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference.
All identity, hairstyle, accessories, and clothing details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image.

Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing:
1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person
2. a black hand-drawn doodle-shadow version of the same character/person on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person and their doodle-shadow are doing a playful mischievous pose together.
The real person performs a cute realistic version of the pose, while the doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version of the same pose idea.
The mood should feel cute, playful, mischievous, stylish, funny, and social-media-friendly.

Real person:
- Must remain realistic and photogenic
- Must wear the same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference image
- Do not replace the reference styling with unrelated fashion
- Expression should be cute, slightly confused, mildly embarrassed, playful, as if thinking: “Why am I doing this with my shadow?”
- The real person should not stand stiffly
- The real person should actively participate in the pose, but in a natural realistic way

Doodle-shadow:
- Must be a black hand-drawn sketch version of the same person, drawn directly on the wall
- Not a realistic second person
- Not a normal physical shadow
- Not a full-color anime character
- Black sketch line-art only
- Should resemble the person through hairstyle silhouette, accessories, outfit silhouette, and pose structure
- The doodle-shadow should look more energetic, sillier, and more chaotic than the real person
- Add manga-like motion lines, hearts, stars, sparkles, and comic marks around the doodle if helpful

Random mischievous pose rule:
The pose must NOT be fixed.
For each generation, invent a new playful mischievous pose for both the real person and the doodle-shadow.
The real person and the doodle-shadow should share the same general pose idea, but they do not need to match perfectly.
The real person performs a cute realistic version.
The doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version.

Do not repeatedly use pointing poses.
Do not repeatedly use finger-gun poses.
Do not repeatedly use the same standing pose.
Do not always make both figures simply point at each other.

Create a different mischievous pose each time.

Possible pose directions are loose inspiration only, not a fixed menu:
- playful idol pose
- silly dance pose
- leaning sideways with one arm curved overhead
- making a big heart pose
- cheeky wink pose
- hands near cheeks in a cute teasing pose
- exaggerated “that's it!” pose
- mock surprise pose
- playful running-in-place pose
- mischievous tiptoe pose
- arms stretched in opposite directions
- pretending to sneak away
- cute troublemaker pose
- dramatic overreaction pose
- goofy victory pose
- playful balance pose
- playful peekaboo pose
- shy but mischievous pose
- cute overconfident pose

The final pose should feel fresh, cute, mischievous, and slightly chaotic.
The real person should look like they are reluctantly playing along.
The doodle-shadow should look like it is having way too much fun.

Composition:
- vertical 3:4 or 2:3
- show the real person in full-body or nearly full-body framing
- place the real person on one side of the frame
- place the black doodle-shadow on a clean wall beside them
- the doodle-shadow should be roughly the same height or slightly taller
- keep enough space around both figures so the full pose is visible
- the connection between the real person and the doodle-shadow must be clear at a glance

Background:
- simple clean indoor studio wall or minimal room corner
- white, cream, or pale gray wall
- clean floor
- soft natural sunlight patch or gentle wall shadow allowed
- keep the background uncluttered

Lighting:
- soft natural studio lighting
- bright, clean, polished, playful mood
- keep the real person’s face clearly visible

Style quality:
- realistic human photography
- black hand-drawn doodle-shadow on wall
- matching mischievous pose interaction
- strong identity resemblance
- outfit and styling faithfully based on the uploaded reference
- cute and stylish mixed-media portrait
- clean composition
- social-media-friendly
- no obvious AI artifacts

Negative prompt:
Outfit change unrelated to reference, realistic second person, normal reflection, normal shadow only, solid black monster shadow, horror shadow, creepy shadow, full-color illustration, cartoon human, anime human, weak resemblance, unrelated sketch character, messy wall, cluttered background, repeated pointing pose, repeated finger-gun pose, same pose every time, fixed pose, boring mirrored pose, stiff pose, identical pose repetition, real person not matching shadow pose, text, watermark, logo, distorted body, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands.

prompts.title: Mid-Air Velocity
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-detail, stylized full-body digital illustration of a man, captured mid-air from a low-angle perspective in a dynamic, energetic action pose. The subject should appear suspended in motion as if jumping, with one leg bent upward and the other extended, creating a strong sense of movement, lightness, and elevation.

Character Identity (Important):
Match the face and identity with high accuracy from the reference image. Do not alter identity or beautify excessively—preserve natural features.

Pose & Expression:
The man is shown in a fluid mid-air jump with the torso slightly twisted to create motion and balance. One arm is extended outward, while the other remains more relaxed. Both legs are posed naturally in a dynamic jump: one knee lifted higher toward the torso, the other leg extending slightly downward to emphasize suspension and movement. His head is tilted slightly upward, with his gaze directed off-frame toward the upper side, conveying confidence, curiosity, and aspiration. His expression is relaxed with a subtle, self-assured smile.

Outfit & Styling:
He wears a layered streetwear outfit consisting of a clean white t-shirt, a dark jacket, and oversized textured grey cargo pants with subtle neon yellow accents. Add modern black sneakers with a clean design and soft shadow definition. The outfit should show realistic fabric texture, folds, tension, and motion consistent with the jumping pose.

Hair & Details:
Dark naturally styled hair with volume and slight motion response. Keep subtle facial details clean and well-defined.

Background:
A bold, vibrant blue background in the #1E79D2 range with a smooth gradient finish. Add abstract black and dark grey paint splatter effects radiating outward from behind the subject to enhance motion, impact, and energy.

Lighting & Rendering:
Use high-contrast stylized lighting with soft highlights and sharp shadow edges. Add subtle rim lighting to separate the subject from the background. Emphasize fabric texture, folds, contours, and form. Include a slight glow from the neon accents for extra visual punch.

Style & Finish:
Modern digital illustration style blending comic, street-art, and semi-realistic rendering. Use crisp linework, painterly shading, and subtle texture overlays. The final image should feel dynamic, clean, energetic, and high-end, with ultra-clean high-resolution 8K-quality rendering.

Composition:
Full-body centered composition with balanced negative space. Use a low-angle, upward-tilted dynamic perspective to capture the subject mid-air and enhance depth, motion, and a sense of elevation. Keep a slight diagonal visual flow for added dynamism. The subject must remain clearly separated from the background, with the splatter effects functioning like motion trails.

Aspect Ratio: 1:1

prompts.title: Vectored Intensity
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4:5 vertical high-contrast vector portrait illustration of a male subject, shown in a dramatic low-angle close-up bust composition. The subject fills most of the frame from the upper chest upward. His face is viewed from below, with the chin raised, neck strongly visible, and head turned slightly toward the viewer’s right. His eyes look upward in the same direction with a serious, calm, aspirational expression.
The composition must feel dynamic and slightly asymmetrical, not perfectly centered or front-facing. Preserve the strong low-angle perspective, sharp jawline, elevated chin, and powerful upward gaze.

Art Style & Rendering
Render the portrait in a premium modern vector pop-art / WPAP-inspired style, using sharp-edged geometric grayscale planes to build the face, neck, and clothing. The shading should be faceted, angular, and high-contrast, with clear polygon-like tonal blocks in white, light gray, mid-gray, dark gray, charcoal, and black. Keep the facial rendering detailed and semi-realistic, not simplified comic art.

No soft blending, no smooth painterly gradients.
Face & Hair
The face should have a sculpted angular structure, detailed eyes, defined brows, realistic nose and lips, and dramatic shadow under the jaw. The underside of the chin and neck should feature deep black and charcoal geometric shadow blocks. If beard is present make it defined.

Hair should be thick, messy, energetic, and sharply jagged, formed from irregular black and dark-gray vector strokes, with a natural chaotic shape rather than neat anime-style spikes.
Clothing
The subject wears a dark crew-neck t-shirt layered under a dark open collared shirt, visible only in the lower portion of the portrait. Keep the clothing simple and secondary to the face, rendered in charcoal, black, and dark gray tones with sharp angular vector folds and high-contrast geometric shading. The clothing should not alter the head angle, neck prominence, portrait framing, or overall composition.

Add a small minimal white generic symbol emblem at the center of the upper chest, placed on the visible t-shirt.
Outline / Edge Glow
Add a bold rough electric-red rim outline around the subject’s outer silhouette, especially along the hair, ear, shoulders, and collar. The outline should feel like a strong graphic edge glow, slightly uneven and energetic, not a clean neon sticker border.

Background
Use a dominantly vibrant red background. Around the edges and behind the subject, place large jagged abstract dark-gray shapes that resemble aggressive angular shards or stylized rough flame silhouettes.

Add only a few controlled white angular accents in the background for contrast. White should remain secondary; the background must still feel mostly red with dark gray impact shapes, not like a white explosion or busy radial burst.
Overall Look
The final result should feel like a bold premium poster illustration:
low-angle upward-looking grayscale vector portrait, dramatic sculpted face, black jagged hair, simple dark crew-neck t-shirt layered under a dark open collared shirt, red electric silhouette glow, red-dominant abstract background with dark gray shards and limited white accents.
Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical.

prompts.title: Inner Prism
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed 4K digital illustration of a male subject presented as a close-up portrait (upper chest and above), photographed at eye level, facing directly forward. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the subject positioned in the middle of a clean, cool white background. The framing must include the full head and upper torso with no head crop, maintaining a balanced 4:5 aspect ratio.
The subject has naturally dark, thick, slightly messy hair with clearly defined strands and realistic texture. He wears distinct black-framed glasses, rendered with sharp detail and natural reflections.
The subject maintains a calm, resolute expression with a direct and thoughtful gaze.
The overall aesthetic combines a grayscale monochrome base for the skin and clothing with dynamic, vibrant multicolored light accents appearing across the face, neck, shoulders, and upper chest. These colors include reds, oranges, yellows, greens, blues, and purples, appearing as if painted or projected light rather than solid paint. The colored lighting should follow facial contours naturally, enhancing depth and structure.
Lighting style is cinematic and high-contrast, with the subject illuminated noticeably brighter than the background to create strong visual separation and focus. The face and upper torso should appear clean, luminous, and evenly lit, with controlled high brightness that enhances facial clarity without overexposure or loss of detail. Highlights should feel crisp and modern while preserving natural skin texture, smooth tonal transitions, and readable shadow depth. The brightness should emphasize facial structure, eyes, and contours, making the subject the clear visual focal point while maintaining balanced contrast.
The effect should resemble a modern graphic-novel or high-end vector illustration, with clean edges, sharp lines, and highly refined textures in hair, glasses, and fabric.
The subject wears a dark ribbed t-shirt, rendered with realistic material texture while remaining consistent with the stylized illustration approach. Eyes should retain a naturally enhanced color intensity without appearing artificial.
The final artwork should feel modern, bold, and visually striking, blending monochrome realism with neon color illumination while maintaining high clarity, precision, and professional illustration quality.
Negative Prompt:
No realistic image
No any color tone on background

prompts.title: Neon Curls

A young woman with dark, textured afro-style hair, gazing upward and slightly to the right of the frame, conveying quiet strength, aspiration, and calm confidence.

Shot from a low-angle (worm’s-eye) perspective, creating a sense of grace and empowerment.
Medium close-up framing, capturing the head, shoulders, and upper chest.
Color Palette & Lighting (Neon-Noir / Synthwave):

Use a triadic color scheme dominated by magenta, cyan, and deep indigo.
Key Light (Magenta / Pink): From the upper right, forming a strong rim light along the hairline, bridge of the nose, left cheekbone, jawline, collarbone, and neckline.

Highly detailed eyes with crisp white catch-lights suggesting multiple light sources, creating a thoughtful, alive expression.

Natural skin texture with smooth gradients and sharp light-to-shadow transitions (near cel-shading) to emphasize facial structure.
Hair Rendering:

Dense mass of tight, coiled curls, rendered with thick, curved painterly strokes.

Magenta and cyan highlights define individual loops, creating volume, glow, and dimensional depth.
Clothing:

Simple, clean-lined t-shirt.

Magenta rim lighting follows the fabric folds and neckline, integrating the subject seamlessly into the neon lighting environment.
Background & Atmosphere:

Soft gradient background transitioning from cyan to magenta, featuring subtle, ghosted palm frond silhouettes.

Strong Retrowave / Miami 80s synthwave aesthetic, atmospheric but non-distracting.
Rendering Style & Quality:

Ultra-clean digital painting with a vector-adjacent yet painterly finish.

Hard and soft edge control, high contrast, cinematic lighting.

No noise, no blur, no flat shading.

4K High resolution, ultra-sharp details, premium editorial illustration quality.
Aspect ratio 4:5.

cartoon, anime, flat illustration, over-smooth skin, plastic texture, muddy colors, low contrast, blurry, washed-out lighting, incorrect face, altered identity, extra accessories, background clutter
